notes.title: ⚙️ Weekly Update: Performance Boosts Before the Break!
notes.notes: [p]This week’s update is all about [b]performance[/b]! We discovered that our [b]detailed voxel damage meshes[/b] were the main culprit behind slowdowns in large-scale battles. The system has now been [b]streamlined and optimized[/b], resulting in [b]major FPS gains[/b] during intense combat.[/p][p]💻 On our old test laptop, we’re seeing [b]nearly double the framerate[/b] in late-game battles! (There [i]are[/i] still some slow-downs when a lot is going on—but we’re on it! 😊)[/p][p]We’re heading out for a short [b]summer break[/b], so the [b]next patch will land in late August[/b]. It’ll be a big one—featuring a [b]UI and skill overhaul[/b], plus the long-awaited [b]Selection Wheel[/b] for building! 🛠️🎯[/p][p][/p][h3]⚔️ Combat & Units[/h3][list][*][p][b]Improved Combat Performance[/b]: Reworked damage mesh code for [b]smoother, more efficient battles[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Platoon Recovery[/b]: [b]Destroyed friendly platoons[/b] are now properly [b]restored after battle[/b], even if fully wiped out.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overcap Platoons Clean-Up[/b]: Friendly platoons [b]above the population cap[/b] are now correctly removed when [b]Barracks are deleted[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ Building & Tools[/h3][list][*][p][b]Hammer Repairs[/b]: The [b]Building Hammer[/b] now also [b]repairs damaged cubes and prefabs[/b], not just builds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Economic Zone Tool Placement Logic[/b]: Tools now [b]avoid blocking doorways or entries[/b] when placed on economic zones.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Edge Placement Fix[/b]: Fixed some tools that could [b]reach beyond the edges[/b] of economic zones.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧠 Minions & AI[/h3][list][*][p][b]Multifloor Pathfinding[/b]: Fixed a rare [b]Unreal Engine bug[/b] causing minions to [b]walk to the wrong floor[/b] in multi-level economic zones.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧱 Prefabs & UI[/h3][list][*][p][b]Prefab Health Bars[/b]: Fixed an issue where [b]health bars stayed hidden[/b] even when prefabs were taking damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Street Building Bug[/b]: Fixed a display bug where the [b]minion count appeared[/b] during street economic zone construction.[/p][/*][/list][h3]💥 Crashes & Stability[/h3][list][*][p][b]Projectile Prefab Crash[/b]: Fixed a [b]crash caused by projectile-type prefabs [/b]trying to fire during destruction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bestiary Crash[/b]: Resolved a [b]crash when opening the Grave Brute entry[/b] in the Bestiary.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🛠️ Build Like You Mean It
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Castle Builders! [/h3][p][/p][p]After our content update last week we're rolling out some features and fixes. [/p][p][/p][p]But before we dive into the details: Did you know that most things in Castle Craft react to physics? Check out this [url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3531890869"]crazy guide by Travis150[/url] on how to use this to your advantage by moving Debimius to safety ("BLASPHEMY" I can hear him shout):[/p][previewyoutube="Lj8_3olPXqA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Here's the full things of goodies for this week:[/p][h3]

🛠️ Gameplay & Balancing[/h3][list][*][p][b]Upgradeable Building Hammer[/b]: The hammer can now be upgraded to build up to [b]25 cubes at once[/b] and [b]instantly complete prefabs[/b] when used.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced Fall Damage[/b]: Falling now results in [b]less damage[/b] to the player, improving traversal and reducing frustration.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧠 AI & Minion Behavior[/h3][list][*][p][b]Smarter Trap Avoidance[/b]: Minions now [b]avoid horizontal spikes[/b] and [b]steer clear of traps[/b] while casually strolling.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🪖 Platoon & Combat Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Ceiling Collision Bug Fixed[/b]: Platoons will no longer get [b]stuck in 2-block-high spaces[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Army Overview Accuracy[/b]: The enemy army overview now has the right duration and is not affected by how many platoons you built.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Launch Pad Reliability[/b]: Launch pads now [b]bounce units properly[/b] even if they still have downward momentum.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧱 Building & Traps[/h3][list][*][p][b]Trap Placement Restrictions[/b]: Traps can [b]no longer be placed inside[/b] resource spots or treasure chests.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trap Collision Fix[/b]: Fixed an issue where trap targets would [b]activate collision prematurely[/b] after placing the first trap component.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Prefab Build Errors[/b]: Fixed a bug causing [b]duplicate error messages[/b] when a prefab build fails.[/p][/*][/list][h3]📝 UI & Text[/h3][list][*][p][b]Platoon Unlock Description[/b]: Corrected the [b]unlock text[/b] for platoons to accurately reflect gameplay.
[/p][/*][/list][p]As always: Let us know if you encounter any issues or have any suggestions for the game! You can [url="https://discord.gg/jes7b7b625"]find us on Discord[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]Best wishes,[/p][p]Marco, Daniel, Jonathan[/p]

notes.title: Economic Zone Update OUT NOW and Roadmap!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Castle Crafters! [/p][p][/p][p]After the early access release we focused on balancing and bug fixes. Now we’re turning our attention to adding some of the bigger features and improvements you have suggested. It took us a bit longer, but we’re finally taking the next step on this journey: the [b]Economic Zone update is here![/b]  In this update we put more power in your hands and allow you to increase the minion and platoon limit by building quarters and barracks.
[/p][p]We have also gotten in touch with the amazing Paul Delaross who gave Debimius the unforgettable voice in the trailer and he’s now also given Debimius his ingame voice.
[/p][p]But wait - we have lots of changes coming to the game in this patch and a quick look to the future and our road map for where we plan to take Castle Craft.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🛠️ Minions:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Quarter Economic Zone[/b]: [b]Increase your minion cap[/b] across all other zones by building these cozy quarters. More minions = more work being done
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Barracks Economic Zone[/b]: [b]Increase your platoon cap[/b] to defend your castle with a bigger army (instead of just more traps).
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Visual Customization[/b]: All minions now have [b]distinct faces[/b] and can be either [b]male or female[/b], so you can personalize your army even more.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minion Build Queue[/b]: In the [b]Economy Tab[/b] of the [b]Skill Book[/b], see exactly which minions are currently being built.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reliable Minion Distribution[/b]: Minions now [b]reliably distribute[/b] across all economic zone clusters. No more empty workshops.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minion Status Icons[/b]: A small icon on the minion status bar now tells you what the minion is currently up to: Is he moving, working, or maybe just taking a break?
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Tool Placement[/b]: Minions now [b]build tools[/b] on all [b]disconnected economic zones[/b], making your fortress even more efficient.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Builders Get Smarter[/b]: Builders now [b]reserve cubes only if nearby[/b], so no more blocking each other when they could be building! They also build nearby cubes first, leading to faster building.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]No More Minion Vertigo:[/b] Minions can now navigate over small bridges/paths of 1 voxel block width, allowing for a wider range of castle constructions.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Productivity Boost[/b]: Builders will now [b]check nearby areas for productive props[/b] and will build new ones if needed. They don’t wait around!
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minions Avoid Launch Pads and other Traps[/b]: Minions will now avoid [b]launch pads[/b]—because no one likes a flying minion, right? Substantively fewer minion deaths all around.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]🎮 General Gameplay:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New Debimius Voice Actor[/b] Enjoy some fresh audio from King Debimius himself, adding even more of his… [i]charming[/i] personality.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Prefab Status Bars[/b]: Only [b]show status bars[/b] for [b]health[/b] and when within range—no more clutter when they're just burning fuel from afar.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Boost[/b]: [b]Performance improvements[/b] when dealing with large economic zones. More minions, more fun, less lag!
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kingdom View Button in Settings Menu:[/b] We’ve added a back to level selection button to the main settings menu that you reach via ESC.
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]⚖️ Balancing:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Increased Difficulty[/b]: The early waves of [b]Stygia[/b] and [b]Hyperborea[/b] are now [b]tougher[/b]. Get ready for more challenges right from the start.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Platoon Food Cost[/b]: [b]Building friendly platoons[/b] (knights and archers) now [b]costs food[/b], adding some strategic depth to your army planning.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tweaked End of Wave Gold Rewards:[/b] Kingdoms now give increasingly larger gold rewards after each wave.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]🐞 Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]No More Floating Trees[/b]: Trees now [b]stay grounded[/b], no more defying gravity.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Friendly Soldier Clipping[/b]: [b]No more soldiers[/b] falling through the ground. They’re now staying put like they should when the world gets restored or loaded.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stygia & Hyperborea Skybox Fix[/b]: The [b]skybox[/b] no longer overlaps with the [b]New Horizons[/b] building border—no more celestial interference.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minion Digging Fix[/b]: Players [b]no longer get pushed[/b] into the air when minions dig underneath them.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hellfire Ability Fix[/b]: The [b]Hellfire dragon[/b] no longer [b]pushes siege towers[/b] away when it’s summoned.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Floating Voxels Fix[/b]: [b]Salvaging[/b] now lets [b]floating voxels[/b] fall to the ground as they should!
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Report Form Fix[/b]: The [b]bug report form[/b] now resets properly after submission—no more issues with it getting stuck!
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tree Growth Fix[/b]: Trees [b]won’t grow[/b] if they were mid-growth when the game was saved.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gold Fix[/b]: [b]Gold in the skill book[/b] now updates properly, even when the building pawn is being possessed.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Food Harvesting Fix[/b]: [b]Food received[/b] from loading a game is now properly counted toward [b]harvested food[/b] in the resource UI.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fall Damage: Double jumping when switching phases[/b]: The player no longer takes fall damage when starting a double jump right before the defense phase begins.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minion Loading: Restoring minions in the first wave[/b]: The game now correctly loads minions even when a game in the first wave is being loaded.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]In addition we will also be releasing the Castle Craft soundtrack by the talented [u][url="https://www.josepavli.com/"]José Pavli[/url][/u]. If you ever found yourself just relaxing to the music while watching your minions work, now you can do the same while doing the dishes… or something more exciting. You get the idea.
[/p][p]While working on the economic zone update, we’ve also continued work on the UI Update, which we will release shortly. This update will introduce a selection wheel to select building skills, revamp the skill book, and lay the groundwork for many exciting additions to the game such as items that you can equip.
[/p][p]Wonder what’s next? We’ve finally created our roadmap that lets you know what Debimius is cooking up for the next patches of the game:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42747663/e8ddca5613b550a28b3ba55d2aa7676a0b52c4cb.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We haven’t put dates on those milestones quite yet. But we expect to have all of them implemented by the end of this year.
[/p][p]The roadmap isn’t set in stone though and YOU can help us shape Castle Craft. [url="https://discord.gg/jes7b7b625"]Join our Discord[/url] and let us know which things you think need to change!
[/p][p]We are grateful for your feedback, your patience, and are excited for what’s to come![/p][p][/p][p]Best wishes,[/p][p]Marco & Jonathan[/p][p]The Castle Craft Crew[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Castle Craft Update: Smarter Minions & Better Pathing! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hello again, Builders & Defenders!

We're back with another quick update that enhances your gameplay experience, making your minions (slightly) smarter and your strategies smoother. Here's what's new:

[h2]Gameplay Improvements 🛡️:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Minions now return resources to the nearest available workstation—efficiency at its best!
[*] Farmers will first gather all nearby pickups before diving back into harvesting, optimizing your resource collection.
[*] Priests are now adept at navigating between temple furniture to fulfill their sacred duties.
[*] Minion pathing significantly improved over long distances—no more ignoring those far away spots!
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes 🐞:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the right mouse button not cancelling the salvage target action as intended.
[/list]

Keep your feedback coming—we're continually refining Castle Craft thanks to your insights!

Build bravely,

🏰 The Castle Craft Team 🏰

notes.title: 🚨 PATCH ALERT: New Updates & Progress for Castle Craft! 🚨
notes.notes:
Hello Castle Crafters! 🏰✨

We’re back with another exciting patch for Castle Craft, and we’ve implemented a bunch of the things you've requested! Not only have we squashed bugs, but we’ve also optimized performance, improved gameplay mechanics, and balanced some key elements to make your castle-building and defense experience even better! 💥

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

[h3]🎮 Gameplay Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resource spots now save and restore when loading/saving. Goodbye re-load resource exploit 🦴
[*] Brute charge attack has been improved for more devastating impact! 💪⚡
[*] Minions now find the closest resource spot they can reach, making resource gathering more efficient.
[*] Rocket artillery’s projectile trajectory and performance have been fine-tuned for a cooler "drunken rocket" behavior! 💥
[*] One-click upgrades for prefabs like windows and doors! 🏗️
[*] Prefab integrity checks optimized for smoother performance.
[*] Telekinesis ability is now more reactive! Grab and throw objects even faster! 🪄✨
[/list]

[h3]⚖️ Balancing Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Friendly archers' range reduced by around 15% to balance the battlefield.
[*] Road now gives a sprinting speed boost, so you can sprint even faster on roads!
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ Quality of Life Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added confirmation prompt when deleting a profile—no more accidental deletions! 🔒
[/list]

[h3]🐞 Fixes Galore:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bomblings no longer become (occasionally) invincible after dying! 🦴
[*] Fixed player equipment visibility when controlling a trap—now it’s all about the traps!
[*] Blade Prison and other skills are now reliably activatable during the combat phase.
[*] Brutes no longer die from fall damage during their charge attack.
[*] Fixed falling kill zone being too high in Stygia—now you can dig all the way to the ground without dying.
[*] Pickup kiting issue when running past a pickup is now fixed.
[*] Iron pickups no longer get stuck inside the iron resource spots.
[*] Fixed wall upgrade ability missing the change grid size sound.
[*] Right Mouse Button no longer cancels digging volume abilities.
[*] Attached prefabs (banners or horizontal spikes) no longer block wall upgrades.
[*] Things no longer attach to banners unintentionally.
[*] Mid-Air Smash can no longer be activated from very low heights.
[*] Climbing and Mjolnir sounds now respect audio volume settings.
[*] Platoon follow/unfollow bug has been resolved—platoons behave as expected!
[*] Flying player pawn no longer takes damage from spikes while in building mode.
[*] Telekinesis projectile no longer lingers mid-air if hitting friendlies.
[/list]

[h3]🔥 Minor Update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fire lights now have a more orange hue than yellow for a warmer, more atmospheric glow.
[/list]

[h2]What’s Coming Next? 🎉[/h2]
We’re also making great progress on our first content patch, and it’s going to be big! Here’s what you can expect:

[olist]
[*] Reworked building menu – Say goodbye to shuffling skills on your skill bar! A smoother, easier interface is coming.
[*] New economic zones: Quarters and Barracks will increase your minion and platoon limits—more builders, more warriors!
[*] Improved procedural level generation – Get ready for even more dynamic, unpredictable battlefields! 🌍
[*] Platoon Command Tool – Easily reposition your platoons in the building phase or command them during the combat phase—tactical freedom at its best! 🔧⚔️
[/olist]


Do you have any issues with Castle Craft? Let us know & we will get it fixed as soon as possible 🔥

The Castle Craft Crew
Philipp, Marco, and Jonathan

notes.title: 🚨 Castle Craft OUT NOW! 🚨
notes.notes:
Castle Craft, the first game from our studio, Twin Earth, is [b]officially LIVE in Early Access[/b]! 🎉 It’s been nearly three years, countless cups of coffee, and a few late-night coding sessions, but the day has finally arrived! 🕒 Dive in and experience chaotic siege battles in a fully destructible world — it’s time to unleash the madness! 💥

[previewyoutube=8sK9S9WhhtM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]What's new?[/h2]
We’ve listened to all your feedback from the demo and made tons of improvements & added a lot of content! 🛠️ The Early Access game includes:

✨ [b]Two brand-new kingdoms[/b] with unique challenges:
[list]
[*] [b]Stygia:[/b] A desert kingdom with skeletons that climb walls and wield sand magic to fight back against your defenses. 🏜️💀
[*] [b]Hyperborea:[/b] An icy wasteland where the mysterious Acolytes summon snow and ice to wield their deadly magic. ❄️🧊
[/list]🌟 [b]Creative Mode:[/b] Play at your own pace with no pressure — summon enemy waves whenever you feel ready! 🏰🛡️

⚔️ [b]New units and traits:[/b] Meet the Acolytes, Elder Things, climbing enemies, enemy bridge builders, and more! 🦴💥

🌍 [b]World Randomization:[/b] Liberated the first three kingdoms? Time to tackle randomized worlds filled with new challenges! 🌱🔥

[h2]I like the game, how can I help?[/h2]
🌟 [b]Buy the game[/b] (it's temporarily 15% off to celebrate the launch!)
🌟 [b]Write Steam review[/b] (Yes, these help aaa looot!)
🌟 [b]Play the game and have fun![/b]
🌟 [b]Give us feedback on our Discord or in the Steam forums![/b] (so we can make Castle Craft even better!)
🌟 [b]And tell your friends about it![/b]

[h2]Why Early Access? 🤔[/h2]
Castle Craft has been shaped [b]by you[/b] — our amazing Discord community! 🙌 Your feedback over the past year has made the game even better than we could have imagined, and we’re excited to continue this journey with your input. [b]We want to hear from you![/b] Join us on Discord to tell us what you'd love to see in the game next! 🔮

[url=https://discord.com/invite/jes7b7b625][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42747663/13fdfaf1915c77bb8b121965e131d5a640da886f.png[/img][/url]

Found any bugs? 🐞 Let us know in our Discord! We're actively reviewing reports and will work hard to help with any issues you may encounter. Your experience matters to us! 💬

Happy building & defending! 
Marco, Philipp, Jonathan

notes.title: Demo Patch Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

We are also happy to finally add custom key bindings to the demo! They will allow non-QWERTY players to customize the game to their liking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42747663/12ff30265560b0a0626e7856eb03890f83ed62cd.jpg[/img]

But wait, there is more in this demo update!

⏳ Gameplay & Controls:
* Pickups now have physics.
* Added more language localizations.
* The salvage tool now highlights things you can salvage (units, traps).
* Large traps now affect Minions navigation, getting them to avoid them.
* Improved target actor when placing cubes horizontally, allowing to place horizontally even in challenging conditions such as very horizontal look-at angle.
* A new settings menu with lots of new options.
* A foliage density option - this helps the game run better on older GPUs.
* Tutorial: The world state now restored after tutorial to avoid possible exploits like collecting infinite resources.
* Reworked skill-bar code that will allow us to add a skill selection wheel in the future.
* Shepherd's View now has a time dillution option for slow-motion and time lapses.
* When a friendly platoon follows you, you can now always let it stop following you with a new key.

🔥 Weapons & Combat:
* Improved cannon and projectile defences behavior: They now ensure they have a line of sight on the target, don’t target units they can’t hit due to the required rotation, and prioritize closer target
* Rocket artillery is doing significantly more damage inside it’s damage radius
* Enemy waves 11-15 are less difficult, they have 1-2 enemy platoons less each.

📷 Audio, Visual & AI Enhancements:
* Increase font sizes across the board: HUD, menu, kingdom info
* Archers don't charge into battle anymore if the enemy units are outside their melee charge range.
* Reduce music volume when the game is paused.

🔥Bug Fixes
* King upgrades are now applied correctly.
* Fixed: Sometimes you could not interact with defences until you moved away and back again.
* Fixed: Blending to black did not alway cover all menu elements.

Let us know what you think!

Happy building & defending,
the Castle Craft crew

notes.title: Besiege meets base building in new action sandbox game Castle Craft
notes.notes:
Take the blocky aesthetics and satisfying base building of Minecraft, combine it with the RTS elements of Age of Empires, and throw in the destructive delights of Besiege. What you've created is Castle Craft, a new action sandbox game all about constructing the ultimate fortress and demolishing any foe that attempts to stop you. Developed by Twin Earth and set to launch in April, you can try Castle Craft right now thanks to a new, free demo available as part of Steam Next Fest.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Demo Patch Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we have just publisher the first patch for the demo, taking various feedback into accound we've received. A HUGE thanks to everyone who has made suggestions and joined our discord. Here are the changes:

⏳ Gameplay & Controls:
* A separate stamina bar that is used for sprinting, double jumps, and shield smashes
* More Build Time in Easy and Default mode.
* Mouse Inversion Option for both character and building pawn.
* Pickaxe Speed Boosts at higher levels.
* Easier waves 1 and 2.
* Improved enemy army positioning.
* The tutorial can be skipped completely via a dialogue option in the first dialogue.
* Friendly archers aim better and predict enemy movement. They also don't charge into enemy units anymore when at a distance.
* We don't teleport minions home anymore if you build economic zones underneath them. We just lift them up.

🔥 Weapons & Combat:
* Improved Ballista and Multi-Ballista: they lock on target quicker and shoot more accurately
* Flamethrower Fixes & Improvements – Crash issue resolved while being destroyed, HUD updated, and fuel recharges faster.
* Smarter Army Composition Algorithm for more of a natural unit placement.
* The sword has a stronger knock-back effect & can be used while jumping
* Improved magnets: They now attract flying units too & have less of a performance impact.

📷 Visual & AI Enhancements:
* Improved Camera Angles when enemy armies spawn.
* Flying Skeleton Bombers Nerfed – Attack speed significantly reduced.

🔥Bug Fixes
* Crash fixed which was due to the flame thrower firing mechanism.
* Some players being stuck in the tutorial after the economic zone part.
* Sometimes brainlings don't get activated and stand around.
* Some players were stuck in the sword part of the tutorial.
* Enemy units now do the correct amount of damage to doors, traps, and other prefabs.

Let us know what you think!

By the way: Did you know that the game has voxel physics and falling voxels damage (friendly and enemy) units? Food for though: Mushrroom Traps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42747663/c00daf10f53139dec5b5c75535580a66e780faf1.jpg[/img]


Happy building & defending,
the Castle Craft crew

notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/LovecraftianDays2024]Lovecraftian Days 2024[/url]

Explore the rich tapestry of kingdoms in Castle Craft, each presenting its own unique set of challenges. During the Lovecraftian Days 2024 festival, have a glimpse into the enigmatic realm of Hyperborea—a land shrouded in mystery and danger, besieged by the sinister Acolytes, a faction inspired by Lovecraftian horrors.

[previewyoutube=3v4AZAiOJk8;full][/previewyoutube]

While the verdant plains of Valusia pit you against the might of conventional siege warfare, Hyperborea offers a departure into the realm of the unforeseen. Here, the Acolytes command forces that defy conventional wisdom, compelling you to evolve your strategies and think beyond the bounds of the ordinary.

The bulwark of your castle remains your last line of defense against the eldritch terrors unleashed by the Acolytes. Yet, victory demands more than strength; it requires ingenuity. You must harness the full potential of your fortress in innovative ways to fend off the encroaching darkness and secure your kingdom's survival.

notes.title: Hero Fest & Internal Alpha Launch Date

notes.title: Introducing the Acolytes
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=IJ-CCEarSYM;full][/previewyoutube]

Introducing the enigmatic Acolytes, a new faction in Castle Craft that hails from the dark and desolate wastelands in the east. These shadowy figures are shrouded in mystery, and few have ever laid eyes on them and lived to tell the tale.

Rumours abound that the Acolytes worship a sinister and unknown deity - one of the ancient and powerful "old ones" who were said to have once ruled the realm. Their devotion to this god is absolute and unwavering, and they are willing to go to any lengths to appease its insatiable hunger for power and destruction.

The Acolytes' dark and twisted rituals are whispered about in hushed tones by those who fear their wrath. And their strange powers and abilities are the stuff of legend - some say they can call forth creatures from the void, while others claim they can manipulate the very fabric of reality itself.

But one thing is certain - the Acolytes pose a grave threat to the kingdom, and their ultimate goal remains a mystery to all. Will the player be able to uncover the secrets of this elusive faction, and put an end to their nefarious plans before it's too late?

notes.title: Castle Craft: Wishlist now!
notes.notes:
[i]Build huge castles in an open sandbox world and defend them against hordes of enemies in siege battles of epic proportions: This is Castle Craft! [/i]

We're excited to finally show the world a first glimpse of what we've been working on. Ever since placing those first voxels more than 10 years ago, we wanted to combine a voxel sandbox with action elements and a tower defense component. After many years of thinking about this, we're finally [b]in full production![/b]

In Castle Craft you build an economy and - with the help of your minions - an impressive stronghold. You then raise an army to defend your castle against waves of enemies of ever increasing military might. Faced with limited resources, you need to make hard decisions: Do you prioritize building impressive defensive structures, improve the equipment of your brave defenders, or turn your character into a powerful war hero? Each decision is associated with its unique play style. 

Find your own way through all the kingdoms in Castle Craft. Your people are counting on you.

Find out more about the team behind Castle Craft on [url=http://www.twinearth.com/]www.twinearth.com[/url]. To stay in the loop about our work follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/TwinEarthGames]twitter[/url]. If this isn't enough for you and you'd like to influence what Castle Craft will ultimately become, you can join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/jes7b7b625]Discord[/url]!
